gloss: that much; to that extent; so much

definitions.gloss: that much; to that extent; so much (as was seen/experienced)
definitions.explanation: Refers back to a degree or extent that both speaker and listener are aware of, often expressing surprise, frustration, or emphasis about how much something was the case.

examples.english: Even though I told you so many times.

examples.japanese: あれほど⟦{練習|れんしゅう}した→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{本番|ほんばん}→本番：19392_honban⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Despite practicing that much, I failed at the real performance.

examples.japanese: あれほど⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Even though I warned you that many times, you're making the same mistake again.

notes:
Part of the こそあど demonstrative system: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧ほど (this much), ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧ほど (that much, near listener), あれほど (that much, shared knowledge). あれほど refers to a degree that both speaker and listener have witnessed or experienced.

USAGE:
Very commonly followed by ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (despite) to express frustration or exasperation. The pattern あれほど〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ conveys 'even though (it was that much / I did it that many times)...'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- あれほど⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: I told you so many times and yet...
- あれほど⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: despite warning you so much...
- あれほど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧: that much effort

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧ほど: to that extent — refers to something closer to the listener or just mentioned; often used in negative sentences (⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧ほどで⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧, not that much)
- ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧ほど: this much — refers to the current situation or something close to the speaker
- ⟦あんな→あんな：01574_anna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: that much — more colloquial; similar meaning but slightly less formal
